Center City Allentown.name: Center City Allentown
Center City Allentown.description: The Hamilton Street CBD with office-to-residential conversions, the PPL Center anchor, and the densest mixed-use pipeline in the Lehigh Valley.

West End Theatre District.name: West End Theatre District
West End Theatre District.description: The West End grid around the Nineteenth Street theatre row with pre-war housing stock and steady renovation trades.

South Bethlehem.name: South Bethlehem
South Bethlehem.description: The Lehigh University-adjacent South Side with student-housing conversions, restaurant-row licensing, and industrial-reuse projects.

Downtown Bethlehem.name: Downtown Bethlehem
Downtown Bethlehem.description: The historic Moravian district and Banana Factory arts corridor with boutique retail and hospitality licensing.

Downtown Easton.name: Downtown Easton
Downtown Easton.description: The confluence of the Lehigh and Delaware rivers with the Crayola-adjacent retail core and the redeveloped silk-mill district.

College Hill.name: College Hill
College Hill.description: The Lafayette College hill neighborhood with solid Victorian stock and investor renovation flow.

South Allentown.name: South Allentown
South Allentown.description: The southward ward along the Lehigh River with craftsman-bungalow stock, a deep rental register, and block-by-block reinvestment.

West End.name: West End
West End.description: The west-of-downtown grid toward the Lehigh Valley Hospital campus with pre-war housing and investor renovation flow.
